reviews.title: Correct reflection, media and authored-source mask coverage
reviews.summary: Source reflection and volume-only video transforms remain partial; displayed-frame-rate measurement is missing. Cached masks preserve dynamic alpha sources but lose authored gradients or reject authored bitmaps. Positive shared tests and targeted WASM/browser probes distinguish these boundaries.

entries.note: Public ordinary AS3 source classes are described; native-base, interface and rest-signature descriptions remain unsupported.
Source-class and selected primitive/class names work; primitive numeric values and native display instances diagnose instead of returning their qualified names.
Source-class and selected built-in superclass names work; primitive numeric values and native display instances are unsupported.
Displayed-frame-rate measurement is unimplemented; the getter echoes the requested receiveVideoFPS value while playing, including before any frame is decoded.
Volume is connected to playback; nonzero stereo pan is rejected and stereo matrix settings are not applied.
Vector and cached dynamic gradient/bitmap masks work; cached authored gradient masks lose their opacity ramp, and authored bitmap sources are rejected.
